name: canvas-plus
description: Use Codex to drive the Canvas Plus project canvas and the film production pipeline through the local Canvas Agent MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Let Codex drive the project canvas and the seven-stage film pipeline.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the local Canvas Agent MCP server so Codex can inspect and edit the canvas, and drive the whole project lifecycle: projects, episodes, shots, the seven production stages, per-item regeneration, assembly and delivery. The project_* tools talk to the gateway directly, so pipeline work does not require the page to stay open.
